subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active-wake provenance be merged by extending the public `AgentSession.steer` shape, or should the rebase keep this provenance plumbing internal while preserving current queued transcript-recorder metadata?
rationale: The runtime direction is plausible, but the branch now collides with current sender/transcript context work and changes public surface budget, so the durable API shape needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Rebase and keep the API narrow
options.body: Refresh the PR so `inputProvenance` and `UserTurnTranscriptRecorder` coexist without exposing more public surface than needed.

options.title: Accept the additive public steer option
options.body: Treat `AgentSessionSteerOptions` as intentional public API and require focused compatibility proof for existing steer callers.

options.title: Pause for a broader provenance design
options.body: Hold this PR until the active wake, sessions_spawn, and channel steering provenance paths have one shared owner-approved contract.

recommendation.title: Rebase and keep the API narrow
recommendation.body: Refresh the PR so `inputProvenance` and `UserTurnTranscriptRecorder` coexist without exposing more public surface than needed.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the active parent wake and subagent completion handoff path that the PR changes.
